text: For many families in Kazakhstan, a week in Turkey or the United Arab Emirates is now easier to organise than a trip to the Altai Mountains or the deserts of Mangystau. This essay will explain why foreign holidays are so popular and suggest how governments and businesses could encourage people to explore their own country.

The main reason is that international holidays often offer better value and convenience. Package tours combine flights, hotels and meals in a single, competitively priced deal, whereas domestic trips may involve long journeys on poor roads and accommodation of uneven quality. Foreign destinations are also heavily advertised, and a trip abroad carries a certain social prestige, especially when photographs are shared online. Finally, many people simply want a complete change of culture, language and climate, which only foreign travel can provide.

Domestic tourism could, however, become far more competitive. The first priority is infrastructure: better roads, regular flights and trains to natural attractions, and clean, affordable guesthouses would remove the main practical obstacles, since many of the country’s most beautiful places are still difficult to reach without a private car. Secondly, tour operators could create holiday packages within the country that are as simple to book as foreign ones. Governments could also promote national destinations through well-made online campaigns, for example by showing canyons, lakes and historic cities through the eyes of popular travel bloggers.

In conclusion, people choose foreign holidays because they are convenient, fashionable and different. If domestic tourism offered similar comfort and was promoted just as effectively, many travellers would discover that remarkable places exist much closer to home.

note.en: States that the essay will answer both questions.
note.kk: Эссе екі сұраққа да жауап беретінін хабарлайды.
note.ru: Сообщает, что эссе ответит на оба вопроса.

note.en: The topic sentence of the causes paragraph.
Compares a foreign package with a domestic trip.
note.kk: Шетелдік тур мен өз елі бойынша сапарды салыстырады.
note.ru: Сравнивает зарубежный тур и поездку по своей стране.

note.en: Turns to the second question: what could change.
note.kk: Екінші сұраққа бұрылыс: нені өзгертуге болады.
note.ru: Поворот ко второму вопросу: что можно изменить.

note.en: The most important measure comes first.
Shows what a campaign might look like.
note.ru: Показывает, как выглядела бы рекламная кампания.

strengths.en: Each question has its own paragraph, so the examiner finds both answers easily.
strengths.kk: Тапсырманың әр сұрағына жеке абзац берілген — емтихан алушы екі жауапты да оңай табады.
strengths.ru: На каждый вопрос задания — свой абзац, экзаменатор легко находит оба ответа.
strengths.example: Domestic tourism could, however, become far more competitive

strengths.en: Inconvenience → infrastructure, packages → local packages, advertising → local promotion.
strengths.kk: Ыңғайсыздық → инфрақұрылым, пакеттік турлар → өз пакеттері, жарнама → өз жарнамасы.
strengths.ru: Неудобство → инфраструктура, пакетные туры → свои пакеты, реклама → своя реклама.
strengths.example: tour operators could create holiday packages within the country that are as simple to book as foreign ones

strengths.en: The Altai and Mangystau make the point about domestic travel concrete.
strengths.kk: Алтай мен Маңғыстау ішкі туризм туралы дәлелді нақты етеді.
strengths.ru: Алтай и Мангистау делают довод о внутреннем туризме конкретным.
strengths.example: a trip to the Altai Mountains or the deserts of Mangystau

strengths.en: The second conditional (If … offered, … would discover) is accurate band 8 grammar.
strengths.kk: Екінші шартты сөйлем (If … offered, … would discover) — band 8 үшін дәл грамматика.
strengths.ru: Второе условное (If … offered, … would discover) — точная грамматика для band 8.
strengths.example: If domestic tourism offered similar comfort and was promoted just as effectively

note.en: Introduction: a familiar comparison (Turkey versus the Altai) and a plan for answering both questions.
note.kk: Кіріспе: таныс салыстыру (Түркия мен Алтай) және екі сұраққа жауап беру жоспары.
note.ru: Введение: узнаваемое сравнение (Турция против Алтая) и план ответа на два вопроса.

note.en: Answer to the first question: price and convenience, advertising and prestige, a wish for change — from main to minor.
note.kk: Бірінші сұраққа жауап: баға мен ыңғайлылық, жарнама мен беделділік, өзгеріс іздеу — басты себептен қосымшаға қарай.
note.ru: Ответ на первый вопрос: цена и удобство, реклама и престиж, желание перемен — от главного к второстепенному.

note.en: Answer to the second question: three measures, each removing a cause from the previous paragraph.
note.kk: Екінші сұраққа жауап: үш шара, әрқайсысы алдыңғы абзацтағы себепті жояды.
note.ru: Ответ на второй вопрос: три меры, и каждая снимает причину из прошлого абзаца.

note.en: Conclusion: the causes in one sentence and the condition for success in the next.
note.kk: Қорытынды: бір сөйлемде себептер, екіншісінде табыстың шарты.
note.ru: Вывод: причины в одном предложении и условие успеха во втором.
